source: Owner direct-chat clarification of the prepared toolkit integration plan
owner_instruction_english_translation: We need destruction transferred only to our lobby map. Initially we can bring the assets from the demo and place them in the lobby so we can destroy them.
decision: Use the existing /Game/Maps/L_OpeningLobby_PainterStone01 as the sole gameplay integration and handoff map. Start by placing a small set of existing imported demo breakable objects and making them destructible with the MeridianSquad rifle.
task_amendment: Keep MSQ-74 and MSQ-149..151. MSQ-149 now delivers several ready-made demo props placed in the actual lobby with the real weapon loop; MSQ-150 stabilizes their debris/reset/change contract; MSQ-151 measures that same lobby placement and slowdown. No separate destruction laboratory or derivative test map is a delivery milestone.
placement_boundary: The owner selects reuse of existing demo props as the initial gameplay placement. Preserve current lobby architecture, materials, lighting, routes, player start, shared assets and unsaved owner edits; add identifiable removable instances in available space. Record source assets/transforms and capture the current saved/unsaved state before mutation. Derive vendor assets only if integration requires changing them. Do not reset the lobby to a historical snapshot.
first_pass: A small set of approximately three to five existing breakable props is a controller planning default, not an owner-specified count. Verify one source with the actual rifle, then place the remaining ready-made props during MSQ-149. Prefer existing behavior; this is not new asset or architecture production.
retained_boundaries: No automatic conversion of existing lobby walls/columns/floor, structural collapse, new art production, final dressing approval or broader architecture resumption. MSQ-131 AI and MSQ-78 traversal retain their independent scope.
execution_boundary: This clarification amends the prepared tasks and authorizes their lobby placement scope. It does not itself dispatch a production worker; tasks remain unassigned backlog with zero runs at this planning update.
supersedes: The no-lobby-placement and separate-fixture location restrictions in NextGenDestruction01-TaskRewrite01 and current NGD planning. LobbyDeferred01 remains applicable outside this explicit gameplay-prop scope. Prior migration acceptance and retired ED starts/waivers remain unchanged.
